user_observation_quote: On the pump cartridge, we have moderate success where the magent is sealed in, but it rattles, and also the very first layer on top of the magnet got a bit wonky.
user_hypothesis_quote: I think in this case, the cause of both is that the magnet was not gripped tightly enough in the X axis or Y axis, that it was too easy to "drop the magnet in" instead of "push the magnet in" as had happened with the aero that worked even better.
test_request_quote: I'd like you to give me some test prints for finding the right friction fit for a pocket for a magnet. We don't need paused prints or large prints, just some small samples in sufficient size in the right orientation that I can try pressing magnents into them and tell you which I like best.
scope: User-reported sealing, rattle and initial roof-layer quality. The proposed X/Y grip cause has not been isolated; open coupons select preferred hand fit without qualifying roof deposition, magnet temperature, strength, assembly retention or lifetime.
